evidence: When tetrakisethylmethylamino hafnium (TEMAH) is used as the metallic precursor to deposit such Hf-based materials, its limited thermal stability can result in precursor decomposition. This paper shows to what extent precursor decomposition affects the growth behavior of the TEMAH /H2O ALD in the temperature range 285–365 °C as well as the properties of the deposited HfO2 layer.
